ddl.value: ("user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "organization_name" IS NULL) OR ("user_id" IS NULL AND "organization_name" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: member_user_or_org

ddl.value: "current_membership_ended_at" IS NULL OR ("current_membership_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "current_membership_ended_at" >= "current_membership_started_at")
ddl.name: member_membership_date_order

ddl.value: "status" <> 'active' OR ("membership_type_id" IS NOT NULL AND "current_membership_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "current_membership_ended_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: member_active_snapshot

ddl.value: "status" <> 'ended' OR ("membership_type_id" IS NOT NULL AND "current_membership_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "current_membership_ended_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: member_ended_snapshot

ddl.value: "status" NOT IN ('awaiting_payment', 'awaiting_approval') OR "pending_membership_type_id" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: member_pending_application_type

ddl.value: ("event_type" IN ('legacy_membership_started_inferred', 'legacy_resignation_inferred', 'legacy_rejoin_inferred', 'legacy_type_changed_inferred') AND "certainty" = 'inferred') OR ("event_type" NOT IN ('legacy_membership_started_inferred', 'legacy_resignation_inferred', 'legacy_rejoin_inferred', 'legacy_type_changed_inferred') AND "certainty" = 'confirmed')
ddl.name: membership_event_type_certainty

ddl.value: "refund_required_at" IS NULL OR "refund_reason" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: payment_refund_reason_required

ddl.value: "refund_confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "refund_required_at" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: payment_refund_confirmation_requires_request

ddl.value: "refund_confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "source" = 'stripe' OR "manual_refund_reference" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: payment_manual_refund_reference

ddl.value: "invalidated_at" IS NULL OR "invalidation_reason" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: payment_invalidation_reason
